ranking.title: 211.46 Ventilation, air filtration, air heating and cooling.

rows.text: Each person engaged in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall have education, training, and experience, or any combination thereof, to enable that person to perform the assigned functions.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To make sure that people who make, pack, test or store products are qualified and trained for their work, and that they do not contaminate the product.

3. Qualification

3.1 Each job has a written description stating the education and experience it needs, and new staff are trained before they work alone. 3.2 Supervisors hold a degree in pharmacy or science and have at least three years in production.

4. Training

4.1 Each person is trained in the SOPs of their own job and in GMP as it applies to that job, and the training is recorded. 4.2 GMP induction training is given by the QA training officer when a person joins.

rows.text: Personnel engaged in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall wear clean clothing appropriate for the duties they perform.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To make sure that people who make, pack, test or store products are qualified and trained for their work, and that they do not contaminate the product.

3. Qualification

3.1 Each job has a written description stating the education and experience it needs, and new staff are trained before they work alone. 3.2 Supervisors hold a degree in pharmacy or science and have at least three years in production.

5. Clothing and hygiene

5.1 Clean factory uniforms are issued every day. 5.2 Hair covers, face masks, gloves and sleeve covers are worn in the dispensing and compression rooms. 5.3 Staff wash and sanitize their hands on entry; eating, drinking and smoking are banned in production areas. 5.4 Only staff whose badge is authorised by the production manager can open the doors of the dispensing and compression rooms.
